arguments.Title: 누락 도로 양끝 연결 조사
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor.SceneManagement; using System.IO; using System.Linq; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { result.Log("map="+GameObject.Find("INHA UNIVERSITY").transform.position+" scale="+GameObject.Find("INHA UNIVERSITY").transform.lossyScale); Physics.SyncTransforms(); for(int n=0;n<=20;n++){var p=Vector3.Lerp(new Vector3(319.02f,0,-113.26f),new Vector3(390.47f,0,31.77f),n/20f); var hits=Physics.RaycastAll(p+Vector3.up*100,Vector3.down,200); result.Log(p+" => "+string.Join(";",hits.Select(h=>h.collider.name+" y="+h.point.y)));} } }
